source: Additional lesson-scoped practice requested after the supplied PDF; the reading article is unchanged.
note: These words share the written character 然. They have different meanings and grammatical roles; this is not a list of synonyms.

words.example: 我先吃早饭，然后去学校。
words.examplePinyin: Wǒ xiān chī zǎofàn, ránhòu qù xuéxiào.
words.exampleEnglish: First I eat breakfast, then I go to school.
words.cloze: 我先吃早饭，_____ 去学校。

words.examplePinyin: Nǐ kěyǐ lái ma? Dāngrán kěyǐ.
words.exampleEnglish: Can you come? Of course I can.

words.example: 他说今天会下雨，果然下雨了。
words.examplePinyin: Tā shuō jīntiān huì xià yǔ, guǒrán xià yǔ le.
words.exampleEnglish: He said it would rain today and, sure enough, it did.
words.cloze: 他说今天会下雨，_____ 下雨了。

words.examplePinyin: Kuài zǒu, bùrán jiù chídào le.
Duō chuān yìdiǎn, yàobùrán huì lěng.
words.exampleEnglish: Wear a little more, or you’ll be cold.

timeContrast.hanzi: 我先吃早饭，然后去学校。
timeContrast.pinyin: Wǒ xiān chī zǎofàn, ránhòu qù xuéxiào.
timeContrast.english: First I eat breakfast, then I go to school.
timeContrast.note: 然后 connects the next action in a sequence.

timeContrast.pinyin: Chī zǎofàn yǐhòu, wǒ qù xuéxiào.
timeContrast.english: After eating breakfast, I go to school.
timeContrast.note: Event + 以后 sets the time: after that event.

timeContrast.pinyin: Yǐhòu wǒ huì zǎo diǎn qǐchuáng.
timeContrast.english: From now on, I’ll get up earlier.
timeContrast.note: 以后 on its own can refer to a later time or to the future from this point onward.
